note: Family campground in rustic woods beside 50-acre, no-wake Kilby Lake, with a heated pool, a pickleball court, boat and paddleboard rentals and a deck overlooking the lake; the sites sit back from the shore. Mostly seasonal: 17 of about 142 RV sites are sold by the night. ATVs may ride only between the site and Fern Avenue or the trail. --Claude
